benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families consisting of husband, wife and minor children with cultivable land in their names, subject to official exclusion criteria and government verification
required_documents: Aadhaar details, Aadhaar-linked bank account and land ownership records; additional requirements may apply
application_process: Register through the official PM-KISAN portal or an authorised Common Service Centre (CSC). Complete mandatory e-KYC. State authorities verify land and beneficiary records.
latest_updates: 24th instalment released on 30 October 2026, reaching over 9.34 crore farmers with more than ₹18,690 crore. Continuation approved for 2026-27 to 2030-31 with an outlay of ₹3.15 lakh crore. e-KYC is mandatory. Certain suspected exclusion cases may have benefits temporarily withheld pending physical verification.
status_as_of: Active; subject to eligibility and verification
